policies.title: Dutch ordinary passports: Djibouti electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Dutch Foreign Ministry guidance directs Dutch-passport visitors to Djibouti's government online visa channel, and Djibouti's certified government guidance says the approved eVisa is emailed before travel and replaces border issuance.
conditions: Applies to a current ordinary Netherlands passport for short visitor travel.
Apply online through Djibouti's government service before travel; the approved eVisa is delivered electronically and replaces the former point-of-entry visa.
The separate embassy application option, work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside this classification.

application.label: Djibouti government eVisa
steps: Submit the visitor application and required documents through Djibouti's government eVisa service before travel.
Use the electronically delivered approval for the journey and present it with the same passport at entry.

policies.title: Dutch ordinary passports: Iran advance visitor visa
policies.summary: The Dutch Foreign Ministry requires Dutch-passport visitors to obtain the Iranian visa through Iran's Embassy in The Hague before travel.
conditions: Applies to a current ordinary Netherlands passport for short visitor travel.
Apply through Iran's Embassy in The Hague before travel; the source does not establish normal visa issuance at the border for this cohort.
Dual Iranian nationals, work, residence, press, pilgrimage, transit, special documents and final admission remain separate.
The Dutch Foreign Ministry advises against all travel; this classification does not imply safety or guaranteed admission.

policies.title: Dutch ordinary passports: South Sudan electronic visitor visa

conditions: Applies to a current ordinary Netherlands passport for short visitor travel.
Apply online before departure and download the approved eVisa PDF for presentation at the port of entry.
Registration after arrival, work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.
The Dutch Foreign Ministry advises against all travel; this classification does not imply safety or guaranteed admission.

application.label: South Sudan government eVisa
steps: Create an account and submit the visa application and fee through South Sudan's government service before departure.
Download the approved eVisa PDF and present it with the same passport at the port of entry.
